messages.text:
"A 2D cyberpunk-style futuristic pixel art game with wave-based survival mechanics where police officers hunt you down. Each wave gets progressively harder, and the more cops you kill, the more points you earn to buy implants that grant abilities or upgrades (every 1 wave, depending on your points, you can buy one or more implants, with a BOSS appearing every 10 rounds). It features a 3-button control scheme: one button is dedicated to a special ability like the Sandevistan, a smash attack, or others. It features a sleek menu inspired by Hotline Miami, while also drawing inspiration from Cyberpunk 2077, Edgerunners, and Katana Zero.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

Built a playable browser game in `index.html`.

- Survive escalating police waves, earn bounty for takedowns, and buy implants between waves.
- Face a Reaper boss every 10th wave.
- Use **WASD / arrow keys** to move, **Space / Z** to strike, and **Shift / X** to activate the Sandevistan dash and slow time. Mouse and touch controls are supported.
- Added a cyberpunk-style title screen, combat HUD, implant shop, and game-over screen.

Assumption: the three actions are movement, strike, and a special ability. I checked the JavaScript syntax and captured a screenshot of the title screen.
